summary: Shared branch policy for integration-base targeting in CI (fail-closed payload), preflight, and pr verify (#1449 / #1448 S1).
migration_impact: Adopters importing the updated plate-pr-gates workflow need vendored src/plate_core or a plate-core release that includes pr_integration_base_gate; missing runtime fails the job instead of warn-only skip.
agent_notes: Use gh plate release status for --base; gh plate pr preflight before create. Parent #1448 remains open until ruleset/onboarding stages land.
merge_blockers: TRUSTED_EXECUTION: pr-gates runs policy from the PR head checkout (PYTHONPATH=src). A required check alone is not authoritative against malicious PR changes; trusted execution (e.g. default-branch/ref-pinned gate or lifecycle App) is a follow-up, not in S1.
PYPI_0.9.0: template pip install plate-core==0.9.0 does not ship pr_integration_base_gate; adopters fail closed until a release includes this module or they vendor src/plate_core.
MAIN_RULESET: S2 still required — pr-gates on main as a required check in GitHub rulesets (Lull/Commemorative evidence).
OVERRIDE_POLICY: #1425 approver-only override labels remain out of scope (#1446 parked).
